name: brand-footer
description: The branded site footer: black band with the gold IOWA lockup, site/contact content slots, and the socket menu (copyright + legal links). Pairs with the Brand Bar.

options.name: healthcare
options.description: Switches the nested Logo to the IOWA Health Care lockup

options.name: parent_site_title
options.description: GUARD ONLY: a truthy value enables the parent_site_title slot wrapper; the prop's value itself is never rendered — content comes from the slot

code.notes: v-if guard at BrandFooter.vue:50; value not interpolated

options.name: breakpoint
options.description: Responsive states: stacked (mobile) → flex columns (md+); logo 128/145/176px

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content beside the logo — typically div.site-name and/or an icon menu (.footer__links--icon)

slots.name: parent_site_title
slots.behavior: Only renders when the parent_site_title PROP is truthy (BrandFooter.vue:50) — slot content alone is not enough

figma.property: Show Contact (boolean) + Contact (address text) + Phone (text) + Email (text)
figma.notes: Figma models the typical slot content: address (brand-footer/text tokens) plus phone/email rows with icons (text-icon tokens) and gold links (link-color)

geometryNotTokenized.links-columns: footer__container--flex @md: flex, wrap, column-gap 1.05rem; links flex 1 1 0; --contact flex-grow 2
geometryNotTokenized.text-margins: p margin-top 0.9rem; p a icons margin-right 0.625rem
geometryNotTokenized.socket-geometry: li padding 0 0.625rem, margin-bottom 0.325rem, 1px right border; first-child flex-basis 100%
geometryNotTokenized.hover-focus: all link groups: text-decoration underline on hover/focus

a11y.notes: Legal links carry clear names (Privacy Notice / UI Nondiscrimination Statement / Accessibility). socket__menu is a bare ul, not wrapped in nav. Icon menu link text hidden via element-invisible (.link-text). Logo carries its own accessible name (contracts/logo.json).

behavior: .site-name and .parent-site-name are shared classes whose base styles live in brand-bar.scss; the footer overrides color/size/weight/background under .footer scope
knownIssues: .footer__links--nav is not used by the Vue component or its stories, but IS a live SiteNow integration class (uids_base.theme adds it to footer menu regions) — the CSS must not be removed
Healthcare leakage: healthcare=true applies the header-tuned logo icon height (logo/icon/height/healthcare) in footer context with no footer-specific override
No Storybook story exercises healthcare=true; no story uses the named parent_site_title/contact_info slots (content goes through the default slot)
